subject: Geografia
description_pt: Identificar e interpretar imagens bidimensionais e tridimensionais em diferentes tipos de representação cartográfica.

components.description_pt: Identificar representações cartográficas bidimensionais como mapas e plantas
components.description_en: Identify two-dimensional cartographic representations such as maps and plans
components.cc_component_description: Identify the geographic patterns of earthquake and volcano locations using maps

components.description_pt: Interpretar informações espaciais apresentadas em diferentes tipos de representações cartográficas
components.description_en: Interpret spatial information presented in different types of cartographic representations
components.cc_component_description: Compare information presented in different formats such as visual, quantitative, and written sources

cc_matches.description: The locations of mountain ranges, deep ocean trenches, ocean floor structures, earthquakes, and volcanoes occur in patterns. Most earthquakes and volcanoes occur in bands that are often along the boundaries between continents and oceans. Major mountain chains form inside continents or near their edges. Maps can help locate the different land and water features areas of Earth.

Compare, integrate and evaluate sources of information presented in different media or formats (e.g., visually, quantitatively) as well as in words in order to address a scientific question or solve a problem.
